description: WHOOP screens NOOP copies, and the ones we skip. Shots refer to docs/whoop-ia.md.

copy.title: Home — rings and My Day
copy.must_match: Date stepper, Sleep / Recovery / Strain rings, My Day sleep and activity rows.

copy.title: Home — journal and dashboard
copy.must_match: Journal week checks, dashboard rows with current, prior, and delta.

copy.title: Home — Stress and Strain & Recovery
copy.must_match: Stress Monitor 0–3 intraday. One dual-axis Strain 0–21 / Recovery 0–100 week chart.

copy.title: Sleep — ring and contributors
copy.must_match: Sleep Performance ring, Hours vs Needed, Consistency, Efficiency, High Sleep Stress.

copy.title: Sleep — last night
copy.must_match: Hours of sleep, overnight HR if samples exist, Light/Deep/REM vs typical, restorative.

copy.title: Sleep — weekly trends
copy.must_match: Weekly bars for series we store: performance, hours, efficiency. Dash or omit the rest.

copy.title: Recovery — ring and contributors
copy.must_match: Recovery ring, HRV, resting HR, respiratory rate, sleep performance, vs last 30 days.

copy.title: Recovery — weekly trends
copy.must_match: Recovery as 0–100 bars colored by band, then HRV / RHR / respiratory as lines.

copy.title: Strain — ring and contributors
copy.must_match: Strain 0–21 ring, zones 1–3, zones 4–5, strength time, steps. Dash zones/strength if missing.

copy.title: Strain — activities and weekly
copy.must_match: Today's activities, then weekly bars for strain, steps, calories when stored.

copy.title: Activity detail
copy.must_match: Strain, time, zones, key stats. Map only when a route exists.

copy.title: Journal
copy.must_match: Home journal opens this. Week days, yes/no behaviors, notes.

copy.title: Stress Monitor
copy.must_match: Gauge 0–3, LOW/MED/HIGH, day chart with night and workouts.

copy.title: Settings / More
copy.must_match: Grouped real controls (units, strap, notifications). No membership commerce.

skip.title: Health / WHOOP Age
skip.reason: WHOOP Age / Healthspan. Do not invent an age. Skip Galleri.

skip.title: Humans
skip.reason: Community / social graph. Out of scope.

skip.title: Coach
skip.reason: Chat coach. Out of scope for Native Home.

skip.title: Membership and shop
skip.reason: Commerce. Not a screen we build.

skip.title: Customize Dashboard
skip.reason: Optional. Default Home pins already follow 9418.
